Maya R.: FYI — prospect (HelixCare) asked for a short multi-region perf run + cost sketch before exec review. Need p95/p99, cold-start penalty, and estimated burst overage cost. Run tomorrow 07:30 PT.
Omar L.: Proposed matrix: single-region baseline, cross-region routing, and failover to hosted. QPS targets: 250/750/1500. Payload mix: 65% tiny (20-60 tok), 25% mid (100-300), 10% long (700-900).
Evan T.: Include a 30s microburst at 4x sustained during sustain. Also toggle KV cache (on/off) and measure cache hit rates.
perf-bot: Scheduled run: start=2026-11-06T07:30:00-08:00, generator=vegeta-llm v1.0, profiles=[250,750,1500], microburst=30s@4x, cache_modes=[on,off], repeat=1.
Maya R.: Security ask: customer wants KMS latency numbers and SOC2 blurb in the report. sec-qa-bot?
sec-qa-bot: SOC2 Type II confirmed. KMS docs: https://redwood.example/docs/kms-integration. Note: in-path Cloud KMS via VPC adds ~5-12ms per call; recommend key-caching where safe.
Omar L.: Ops — capture TLS handshake latency, conn reuse, ephemeral port counts, KMS 429s, and trace spans for fallback. Also snapshot GPU mem and batch size histogram.
Evan T.: For pricing: give monthly burn at sustained qps and per-minute microburst cost at 2x/4x. Also show delta for quantized model (4-bit) vs baseline.
Maya R.: Draft a one-page report template: TL;DR, run matrix, p50/p95/p99 table, cold-start timeline, burn estimate, security appendix. Keep it tight.
perf-bot: Run started (5567891001). Will post samples after each profile completes.
Maya R.: Thanks team — tagging @Omar L. for pricing calc on first samples. :thumbsup:
